name: Kickabout
summary:
Created by the Lead Designer of Guitar Hero and creator of Slope, Rob Kay, Kickabout brings high-speed physics and kinetic chaos to tabletop football.

The finger football controls are easy to pick up but difficult to master, the game delivering fast-paced, two-minute matches inspired by foosball and air hockey. As a Universal App for both iPhone and iPad, it offers a single-handed portrait mode ideal for commutes, as well as a spacious digital tabletop experience built for face-to-face action.

Whether diving into solo competition or hosting a local multiplayer match, Kickabout is designed for instant accessibility and deep skill development. Single-player mode lets gamers collect and represent 40+ national teams while climbing the global leaderboard, while two-player local multiplayer turns any shared device into a lively, competitive party game.

Built as an indie passion project, Kickabout delivers accessible, skill-based arcade sports action for quick gaming sessions on the go.
